briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 escalate frontier model race with multi-agent breakthroughs

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: AI development accelerates in Q3 2026 with record funding and model releases. Major labs push boundaries in reasoning and agents while regulatory scrutiny intensifies globally.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced multi-agent orchestration; xAI launched Grok-4 featuring 10T parameters. Anthropic's Claude 4 and Google's Gemini 3.5 compete closely on benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act amendments target agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra chips at scale; Microsoft and Google announce $20B combined data center expansions in Asia. TSMC reports record AI wafer demand.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems achieve autonomous goal alignment by 2028 without centralized oversight?
